topics.headline: HY spread at 2.75% amid hawkish Fed rate-path shift
topics.summary: The ICE BofA US High Yield OAS sits near multi-decade tights at 2.75%, but the Fed's June SEP raised its 2026 median rate projection to 3.8% (from 3.4%) while dropping forward guidance, a hawkish surprise that could pressure risk sentiment and widen spreads. Beyond this, there's little fresh signal across other categories right now.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETF flows turn positive after record 10-day outflow streak
topics.summary: Bitcoin ETFs snapped a historic outflow run with $221.72M in inflows on July 2 and $352M over the past week, but sentiment remains fragile with Bitcoin near $62,852 and Fear & Greed at 22 (extreme fear), so continued net inflows over the next 7 days are plausible but not assured.

topics.headline: VIX spikes 17% on Iran strikes, now above trailing 3-month average
topics.summary: Fresh U.S.-Iran military escalation and a looming July 24 tariff deadline pushed VIX to 18.85, already exceeding its trailing 3-month average of 17.70, while elevated OVX, MOVE, and SKEW readings suggest volatility pressure could persist through the 30-day window.

topics.headline: Microsoft-Chevron 20-year PPA anchors wave of new AI power deals
topics.summary: Microsoft just signed a 20-year, 2 GW power purchase agreement with Chevron's Energy Forge One for its Texas data center campus, part of a broader burst this week of hyperscaler-linked power deals (National Grid-Joulent, GridMarket-Deployable Energy, Meta-Reliance) confirming the question resolves yes; regulatory activity in Virginia and Wisconsin shows policymakers reacting to, not enabling, this buildout.
